title: Fixed November-through-April Bitcoin long-or-cash calendar policy
thesis: A fixed November-through-April UTC season may have better subsequent Bitcoin return-to-path-risk economics than May through October, but conflicting published Bitcoin findings require a direct matched-capital replication rather than an imported seasonal-alpha claim.
mechanism: At the first BTC H1 open at or after 00:00 UTC on each calendar-month boundary, hold full-capital unlevered BTC during November, December, January, February, March and April, and hold zero-yield cash during May through October. Use one exact variant only. Do not shift boundaries, select months, add a January, quarter, weekday, trend, volatility, macro, on-chain or event interaction, invert the season, fractional-size or short.
economic_rationale: The rule trades only at two state changes per year and can reduce exposure during a historically proposed weak half-year. It is useful only if explicit-cost Design and Validation total return remains positive, drawdown and Calmar improve enough to offset foregone upside, annual and seasonal-episode support is broad, and terminal inventory remains fully visible.
